content: Xari mɨkwana
Hikɨ tamamata tukari 'umiekaku meta tamamata metseriyaritsie yaxeikɨa 'atanauka wiyaritsie, Yawé yuniuki kaneniutaxatɨani:
«Tewi pemunu'aya, 'ikɨ tukariyari kenaka'utɨa, 'ikɨ tukariyaritsie kwitɨwa, karikɨ Wawiruniya kwieyaritsie ti'aitame hikɨ 'ari kanayeyani Kerutsareme hepaɨtsita.
'Ikɨ teɨteri 'axamemɨteyurie 'inɨarikɨ ketiniwarutaxatɨa, keniwarayemari'itɨa Yawé naimekɨmɨyɨwe mɨpaɨ kanaineni:
»”Yawé naimekɨmɨyɨwe mɨpaɨ kanaineni:
»”Yawé naimekɨmɨyɨwe mɨpaɨ kanaineni:

content.text: Wai xekeneuka'itsarita meta tupiriya 'aixɨa meyuruwa xekeneukanɨitɨa,

content: »”Kerutsareme, ne nepɨmatsi'itimɨkɨkai 'aixɨa nematsiyurimɨkɨkai, ke'axapemɨtiyurienekai 'ahiwe'erikakɨ, peru pepɨka'uyutawaɨri 'aixɨa nematsiyurienikɨ. 'Ayumiemeri, peka'itiyatɨ pekanayeimɨkɨ, 'atsitake petikwineme nehaxɨakɨ.

Ne, Yawé mɨpaɨ nekanaineni, meta nekaneye'atɨamɨkɨ. Nekɨmana yanekatiniyurimɨkɨ, neka'ipatatɨ. Nepɨkamatsitinenimayata 'axakepemɨtiyuriene kemɨmatinake meta kepemɨtiuyeika. Yawé naimekɨmɨyɨwe mɨpaɨ nekanaineni”».
'Etsekieri 'ɨyaya kemɨtiumɨ
Yawé mɨpaɨ kanetiniutaxatɨani:
«Tewi pemunu'aya, 'a'ɨya nekamaninawairiemɨkɨ 'atsipekatimaikaku mɨmatsinake pemixeiyanikɨ. Peru pepɨkahatsuakani nimeta pepɨka'ahiwerieka, pepɨka'ipitɨaka meta 'a'ukai manayeneikani.
Ketineunewi xeikɨa kayuwatɨ, pepɨka'ahiwerieka mɨkite wahetsiemieme. 'Amu'utsie kenayuhɨa tuwaxakɨ, 'akakaitsie keneukexɨa, meta 'amɨxiya pɨkamatsiheukunaka meta paa pepɨkakwaka hiwerikapa mieme».
Ximeri nekatiniwaretaxatɨani teɨteri, peru taikai ne'ɨya kanemɨni. 'Uxa'arieka yanekatinekayani kemɨnetiu'aitɨa.
Teɨteri kiekatari mekaneneta'iwawiya: «¿Kamɨtsɨ pekatatitaxatɨani ketita mɨti'inɨariyari, 'ikɨ 'inɨari titahetsiemieme yapemɨtiyuriene?»
Ne mɨpaɨ netiwareta'ei: «Yawé neretaxatɨaka yuniukikɨ mɨpaɨ pɨneretahɨawixɨ,

keniwaraye'eritɨa 'Ixaheri teɨterimama, Yawé naimekɨmɨyɨwe mɨpaɨ kanaineni: “Ne netuki kapatsiekame nekanayeitɨamɨkɨ, tuki xexeiyatɨ xepauyɨ'ɨ witsixepɨte'ixeiya, waɨkawa xeminaki'erie. Xeniwema 'ukitsi meta 'ukari xemɨwaruku'eiri, 'ixiparakɨ mekanikwi'iwakuni,
xemeta yaxeikɨa xekateniyurikuni nehepaɨ, mɨxiya xepɨka'anuku'eima meta paa hiwerikapa mieme xepɨkatikwani.
Tuwaxakɨ yumu'utsie xekenayuhɨaxɨa, meta yukakaitsie xepeu'uixuani. Hawaikɨ xeka'utitsuatɨ xekayuhiwerietɨ, matsi pɨta xekanitipɨnikuni 'axamɨti'anekɨ xete'uka'eniwatɨ hipatɨta xehamatɨa.
'Etsekieri matsi kani'inɨaritɨkamɨkɨ, xemeta yaxeikɨa xepɨteyurieni mɨkɨ mɨtiuyuri hepaɨ. Kepauka mɨpaɨ mɨtiyɨni, 'ana mɨpaɨ xekatenetimaikuni ne Yawé naimekɨmɨyɨwe nemɨhɨkɨ”.

»'Ekɨ tewi pemunu'aya, tukari maye'anitsie tuki nemɨwanawairienitsie muwanake memixeiyanikɨ, yu'iyaritsie ketita memɨtehiwe'erie, ketitatsie memɨteuyɨ'ɨ, wananai meta watemawierika, meta waniwema 'ukitsi 'ukari,
xewitɨ yu'uname kamatinitaxatɨamɨkɨ kemɨreyɨ.
Mɨkɨ tukaritsie kwitɨ 'anení pukuyuani peniuwetɨ pepayani. Hikɨ 'anari pepɨtitaxata yu'uname hamatɨa, 'inɨari pepayani wahetsiemieme, hikɨ mɨpaɨ mepɨtehetimani ne, Yawé nemɨhɨkɨkɨ».
